args.text:
name: venice-repo-requirements-audit
on:
  push:
    branches: ['venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1']
    paths: ['docs/venice-audit-v1/**', 'tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py', '.github/workflows/venice-repo-requirements-audit.yml']
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: venice-repo-requirements-audit
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout audit branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install pytest
        run: python -m pip install --quiet pytest
      - name: Build matrices from authority files
        run: python docs/venice-audit-v1/build_matrices.py
      - name: Run source-matched tests
        if: hashFiles('tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py') != ''
        run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py
      - name: Commit regenerated matrices
        run: |
          git config user.name 'venice-audit-bot'
          git config user.email 'venice-audit-bot@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add docs/venice-audit-v1
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'no matrix changes'
          else
            git commit -m 'audit: regenerate matrices from main authority files'
            git push origin HEAD:venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1
          fi
